headline: Application role granted wildcard S3 access instead of specific buckets

findings.evidence_ref: IAM policy Resource field changing from ["arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data","arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data/*"] to ["*"] in the plan output
findings.explanation: The application role can now read, write, and list every S3 bucket in the account, not just the intended production data buckets. This violates least-privilege access and exposes all bucket data to the application.
